issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Achievements "Active Streaks" card never renders — GET /gamification/overview streaks block is fed by dead GamificationProfile counters.

get_gamification_overview() (nyu_backend/app/services/gamification_service.py:599-607) sources streaks.tracking_days / workout_weeks / step_goal_days / checkin_days and longest_tracking / longest_workout from GamificationProfile.tracking_streak_days etc. Those columns are written ONLY inside gamification_service.process_streak(), which is UNWIRED — it has no production caller (the live streak engine daily_report._evaluate_streak writes FitnessPlan.current_streak instead; checkin_streak_days has no writer anywhere). So all four gate fields are permanently 0 in prod.

Achievements.tsx:116-119 gates the whole section on hasActiveStreaks = tracking_days>0 || workout_weeks>0 || step_goal_days>0 || checkin_days>0. Because those are always 0, the Active Streaks card — plus the live "N freezes left" sub-label and the Best-tracking/Best-workout line nested inside it — NEVER show, even for a user with a real multi-day streak.

Expected: a user with an active streak (visible on the dashboard / GET /gamification/streak, which reads FitnessPlan.current_streak) sees that streak on /achievements.
Actual: the Active Streaks section is absent for every user.

Repro: (1) log daily so FitnessPlan.current_streak >= 1; (2) GET /api/v1/gamification/streak returns current_streak>0 while GET /api/v1/gamification/overview returns streaks.tracking_days=0; (3) open /achievements — no Active Streaks card.

Fix: in get_gamification_overview() source tracking_days/longest from FitnessPlan.current_streak/longest_streak (mirror the /gamification/streak route + backend.py:3701), or wire process_streak() into the nightly pipeline. freeze_available (line 606) is already live — only the count fields are dead.

No new screen, no favorites list yet (that would be v2). Effort: ~1-2 days FE (action + duplicate-log API call) + confirm backend already exposes a create-meal-log endpoint that accepts prefilled macros (likely yes, reused by manual entry).

issues.reviewReason: Progress page: user completed 2 workout SESSIONS but Activity days shows 0/14, Activity streak 0d, and 0/N activities logged. Root cause (verified in backend.py): the page draws from TWO independent data sources. 'Sessions X/Y' counts WorkoutSessionLog rows (completed workouts, calculate_on_track_metrics). 'Activity days', 'activities logged (N%)', and the Diet/Activity/Healthy/Weeks STREAKS all count DailyLog.activity_completed (calculate_activities_done + the streak helpers) - a separate daily activity/walk marker set by the 'Log Activity' button. Completing a scheduled workout does NOT set DailyLog.activity_completed, so a user who does their workouts but never taps 'Log Activity' sees sessions>0 while every activity/streak metric stays 0, which reads as 'activity data is missing'. This is currently by design (the weekly-insight copy says 'a short walk counts', implying activities are supplementary movement distinct from planned workouts). PRODUCT DECISION: should completing a workout session auto-mark that day's activity done (so Activity days + Activity/Healthy/Week streaks reflect it)? RECOMMENDATION: yes - on WorkoutSessionLog completion, set DailyLog.activity_completed for that date; makes effort visible and matches expectation. CAVEAT: changes activity/streak semantics for ALL users retroactively and feeds gamification XP/badges, and I cannot verify headless (no QA account with a plan+streak; provisioning declined). Confirm and I will implement + deploy. Side-find: coach FAB briefly shows a doubled 'Ask Jasmine' label (img-3) during the nudge-in transition (two AnimatePresence label nodes overlap); I can fix that independently.

Fixing means upgrading packages on the LIVE Python 3.8 prod venv - owner/security territory that risks an outage with no human to validate, and CLAUDE.md already records that a cryptography/pyOpenSSL upgrade previously broke eventlet. Categorized so you can approve a safe subset: SAFE minor/patch (security-relevant, low API risk): flask 3.0.3->3.1.3, werkzeug 3.0.6->3.1.6, requests 2.32.4->2.33.0, urllib3 2.2.3->2.5.0, pyjwt 2.9.0->2.13.0, mysql-connector-python 9.0.0->9.1.0, python-socketio 5.14.3->5.16.2, python-dotenv 1.0.1->1.2.2, pyyaml 5.3.1->5.4, plus pygments/mako/mistune/msgpack/h2/httplib2/click. RISKY major bumps (need staging + smoke test): cryptography 47->48 (eventlet history), flask-cors 5->6, pillow 10->12 (image pipeline), pynacl 1.3->1.6, protobuf 5->6, setuptools 75->83, pytest 8->9 (dev-only), eventlet 0.39->0.40 (backend runs async_mode=threading so low impact). Low relevance to the running app: yt-dlp, wheel, pip, future, filelock, configobj. RECOMMENDATION: on a staging clone bump the SAFE set, run the backend pytest suite, then deploy; schedule the RISKY majors separately with per-package smoke tests. I will NOT upgrade a live prod venv unattended. Full JSON list available on request.
